The '''LuxurPort Zisparanza''' luxury [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] was manufactured by [[Ubrikkian Industries/Legends|Ubrikkian Industries]].

==Characteristics==
The LuxurPort Zisparanza was the archetype of the luxury vehicle. Its exterior was paneled in scarlet-hued [[Greel wood/Legends|greel wood]] with [[Silver/Legends|silver]]-[[Chromium/Legends|chromium]] alloy details. Too tasteless for some, it caught on quite well with [[Gangster/Legends|gangsters]] and other crime figures.<ref name="HSCS" />
